apiBoundary: src/services/api.ts — all backend/OCC calls go through this module; no inline fetch/HTTP in components

build.UNIT_TEST: MANUAL: no unit runner configured — the gate is TYPECHECK + LINT + BUILD + E2E_TEST. Add Vitest + React Testing Library if/when introduced, then point UNIT_TEST at 'npx vitest run'.

researchLayers.name: components
researchLayers.targets: src/components/, composition, props contracts, styling usage

researchLayers.name: state
researchLayers.targets: src/contexts/, custom hooks, URL-driven state, window events

researchLayers.name: api-types
researchLayers.targets: src/services/api.ts methods, src/types/index.ts shapes, OCC backend contracts, auth/session lifecycle

_notes: Starter profile for a React + Vite + TypeScript storefront over SAP Commerce OCC (matches the sap-mcp-ui-l shape). Copy to working-docs/config.json and adjust.

The repo's CLAUDE.md is authoritative: functional components + named exports, ALL backend calls through the apiBoundary (src/services/api.ts), typed responses, loading + error states on every async op, Tailwind class ordering.
Testing gate is TYPECHECK + LINT + BUILD + E2E_TEST (Playwright, tests/*.spec.ts) — there is no unit runner by default. Wire UNIT_TEST only once a runner is added.
This is the counterpart to composable-storefront.json: use react-vite for a React/Vite storefront, composable-storefront for Angular Spartacus. Same storefront-qrspi skill — only the config differs.
Set jira.mode to 'mcp' if the Atlassian MCP connector is available; 'manual' otherwise; 'none' if no Jira.
